rationale: Lo schema split tra cosmetic ownership (account-wide) ed equipped/usage state (server-bound) non puo essere applicato in questo task perche richiede: (1) DB migration/backfill esplicitamente vietato; (2) cambio di destinazione di scrittura/lettura per equip endpoint = behavior change vietato; (3) decisione prodotto multi-server (default state su nuovo server, ereditarieta dei flag bronze) non risolta. Il refactor e' pronto come blueprint e attende un task gated dedicato con autorizzazione esplicita per migrazione/backfill.

reasons_blocking_apply: DB_MIGRATION_REQUIRED: existing user_cosmetics docs contain active_* fields that must be migrated to a new user_cosmetics_equipped collection (server_id='s1') for read consistency, otherwise GET /cosmetics would lose equipped state for existing users.
BACKFILL_REQUIRED: every existing user_cosmetics doc would need a synchronous backfill op; explicitly forbidden by task scope.

BEHAVIOR_CHANGE_REQUIRED: POST /cosmetics/equip would change write target collection; on the read path GET /cosmetics would change to dual-collection read; this changes observable runtime behavior even if outputs are equivalent.

PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED_DEFAULT_FRAME: in multi-server design, on a brand-new server profile the user starts with default frame 'bronze' (current single-server constant). Is this the same on all servers, or should it inherit from s1? Open product decision.
PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED_ACTIVE_INHERITANCE: when a user opens a 2nd server profile, should active_aura/active_frame transfer from s1 (default) or reset to None/'bronze'? Open product decision.

CANONICAL_COLLECTION_NAME_DECISION: rename user_cosmetics ⇒ user_cosmetics_ownership for clarity, or keep historical name and only add user_cosmetics_equipped? Open decision impacting downstream code paths.

phase_A_design_only_no_runtime.description: Document target schema, dual-collection read path, write splits, default frame policy, inheritance rules. NO runtime change.

phase_B_migration_gated.description: Backfill ALL existing user_cosmetics docs: copy active_* fields to new user_cosmetics_equipped(user_id, server_id='s1') docs. NO field removal yet (dual-write compat).

phase_C_dual_write_runtime.description: Patch cosmetics.py to write active_* to BOTH old field on user_cosmetics AND new user_cosmetics_equipped (dual-write); read from new collection with fallback to old.
phase_C_dual_write_runtime.rollback: revert to single-write on old collection

phase_D_cutover_runtime.description: After dual-write stabilized, stop writing active_* on user_cosmetics; read only from new collection.

phase_E_cleanup.description: Backfill removes orphan active_* fields from user_cosmetics docs.
